name: American Studies and Ethnicity (Chicano/Latino Studies) (BA)
intro: Chicano/Latino Studies is a multidisciplinary program designed to provide students with a critical understanding of the historical, cultural, social and political experience of Chicanos and Latinos, with a particular emphasis on the development and culture of the ​Chicano/Latino communities in California and the West as well as on both historical and contemporary effects of global issues on Chicano/Latino communities
